results.title: Prime powers fixed by a uniform power sum of their prime factors
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: For positive integers $y$ and $s$, let $T_s(y) = \sum_q e_q q^s$, where $q$ runs over the primes dividing $y$ and $e_q$ is the exponent of $q$ in $y$, so that each prime factor is counted with multiplicity. Let $p$ be a prime, let $m$ be a positive integer and let $y = p^m$. Then for every positive integer $s$, $T_s(y) = y$ if and only if $m = p^k$ and $s = p^k - k$ for some natural number $k$.

results.summary: For every cylinder event `A` and `ε > 0` there is a translation `g` with `|μ(A ∩ g⁻¹A) - μ(A)²| < ε`.

results.title: Cylinder approximation of events under a finite measure
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: Every measurable event is approximated by a cylinder event in symmetric difference; the general form of `exists_cylinder_symmDiff_lt` (`Ergodicity`).

results.title: Translation-invariant self-mixing measures are ergodic
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: A translation-invariant self-mixing probability measure is ergodic.

results.title: Event that every coordinate of a finite set is open
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The event `O_T` that every coordinate in `T` is open. See also `cdc_multiOpenEvent` and `med_genericMultiOpenEvent`.

results.title: Coordinate state as a real number
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The state of coordinate `e` as a real number in `{0, 1}`.

results.title: Product indicator of a multi-open event
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The indicator of `O_T` as the product `∏_{e ∈ T} ω(e)`.

results.title: Indicator of agreeing with a pattern on a finite set
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The indicator that `ω` agrees with `τ` on `F`.

results.title: Inclusion–exclusion coefficient of a multi-open event
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The inclusion–exclusion coefficient of `O_T` in the expansion of the trace indicator of `τ` on `F`.

results.title: Pair mixing of multi-open events
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: For every finite family of finite sets `T` and `δ > 0` there is one translation `g` with `|μ(O_T ∩ g⁻¹O_{T'}) - μ(O_T) μ(O_{T'})| < δ` for all `T, T'` in the family.

results.title: Mixing for finite families of cylinder events
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The analogue of `fmu_PairMixing` for finite families of cylinder events.

results.title: Upper decay of correlations of multi-open events
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The one-sided form of `fmu_PairMixing`: `μ(O_T ∩ g⁻¹O_{T'}) ≤ μ(O_T) μ(O_{T'}) + δ`.

results.title: Extreme point of the invariant probability measures
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: `μ` is a translation-invariant probability measure that is not a nontrivial convex combination of two distinct translation-invariant probability measures.

results.title: Extreme invariant measures are ergodic
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: An extreme point of the translation-invariant probability measures is ergodic.

results.title: Conditional product cap for multi-open events in boxes
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: For every finite family of finite edge sets and box index `N`, some translation `g` satisfies, for all large `m`: each `O_T ∩ g⁻¹O_{T'}` is `A ∩ B` on `Λ_m` with `A` increasing and `B` depending only on edges outside some `F`, the conditional masses of `A` on the fibres of `F` (with a boundary graph containing the wired one) are at most `μ_N(O_T)`, and the mass of `B` is at most `μ_N(O_{T'})`.

results.title: Far-box product domination of multi-open events
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: For every finite family of finite edge sets, box index `m`, and `δ > 0`, some translation `g` satisfies `μ(O_T ∩ g⁻¹O_{T'}) ≤ μ_m(O_T) μ_m(O_{T'}) + δ` for all `T, T'` in the family.

results.title: Finite-box disjoint product domination of multi-open events
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: For every finite family of finite edge sets and box index `N`, some translation `g` satisfies, for all large `m`, `μ_m(O_T ∩ g⁻¹O_{T'}) ≤ μ_N(O_T) μ_N(O_{T'})` for all `T, T'` in the family.

results.title: Translated wired box measure
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The wired finite-volume random-cluster measure on `Λ_n` translated by `g`.

results.title: Translated free box measure
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The free finite-volume random-cluster measure on `Λ_n` translated by `g`.

results.title: Wired integral shift decay along a box sequence
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: Along the box sequence `φ`, the wired box integrals of `f` and of `f ∘ θ_g` differ by a quantity tending to zero, for every bounded continuous `f`.

results.title: Free integral shift decay along a box sequence
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: Along the box sequence `φ`, the free box integrals of `f` and of `f ∘ θ_g` differ by a quantity tending to zero, for every bounded continuous `f`.

results.title: Wired translation invariance from integral shift decay
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The wired infinite-volume FK measure is translation invariant if the integral decay hypothesis holds for every shift and every convergent box subsequence. See also `flc_wiredIV_isTranslationInvariant`, which proves invariance for `q = 2` without hypotheses.

results.title: Free translation invariance from integral shift decay
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The free infinite-volume FK measure is translation invariant if the integral decay hypothesis holds for every shift and every convergent box subsequence. See also `bdp_freeIV_isTranslationInvariant`, which proves invariance for `q = 2` without hypotheses.

results.title: Identity shift satisfies the wired decay hypothesis
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The identity shift satisfies the wired decay hypothesis, so it is not vacuous.

results.title: Identity shift satisfies the free decay hypothesis
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The identity shift satisfies the free decay hypothesis, so it is not vacuous.

results.title: Shift-decay functional of a sequence of measures
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The difference `∫ f dμ_n - ∫ f ∘ θ_g dμ_n` between the integrals of `f` and of its shift by `g` against the `n`-th measure.

results.title: Shift decay extends from a dense set of test functions
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: If `D_n(f') → 0` for all `f'` in a dense set of bounded continuous functions, then `D_n(f) → 0` for every bounded continuous `f`. This is the equicontinuity argument of `EquicontinuousAt.tendsto_of_mem_closure`, specialized to the uniformly Lipschitz family `f ↦ D_n(f)`.

results.title: Wired shift decay on a dense set of test functions
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: Decay of `D_n` along the wired box measures `φ^1_{Λ_{φ(n)}}` on some dense set of bounded continuous functions.

results.title: Free shift decay on a dense set of test functions
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: Decay of `D_n` along the free box measures `φ^0_{Λ_{φ(n)}}` on some dense set of bounded continuous functions.

results.title: Wired translation invariance from decay on a dense set
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The wired infinite-volume FK measure is translation invariant if, for every shift and every convergent box subsequence, `D_n` decays on a dense set. See also `flc_wiredIV_isTranslationInvariant` (unconditional for `q = 2`).

results.title: Free translation invariance from decay on a dense set
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The free infinite-volume FK measure is translation invariant if, for every shift and every convergent box subsequence, `D_n` decays on a dense set. See also `bdp_freeIV_isTranslationInvariant` (unconditional for `q = 2`).

results.title: Edge-open indicator as a continuous function
results.caption: Definition

results.title: Edge-open indicator as a bounded continuous function
results.caption: Definition

results.title: Wired box integral of an edge indicator is the wired edge marginal
results.caption: Lemma

results.title: Free box integral of an edge indicator is the free edge marginal
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The integral of the indicator of a box edge against the free box measure on `Λ_m` is the free edge marginal.

results.title: Decay of the edge-indicator functional from equal wired densities
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: If the box edge `e` and its shift `g⁻¹ e` have the same wired `q = 2` density, the decay functional of the indicator of `e` along the wired box measures tends to zero.

results.title: Cylinder algebra generated by edge indicators
results.caption: Definition

results.title: Cylinder algebra as bounded continuous functions
results.caption: Definition

results.title: Density of cylinder functions among bounded continuous functions
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The cylinder functions are dense in the bounded continuous functions, by Stone–Weierstrass on the compact configuration space.

results.title: Cylinder decay along the wired box measures
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The decay functional tends to zero along the wired box measures for every cylinder function.

results.title: Cylinder decay along the free box measures
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The decay functional tends to zero along the free box measures for every cylinder function.

results.title: Translation invariance of the wired FK measure from cylinder decay
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The wired infinite-volume FK measure is translation invariant if cylinder decay holds for every shift and every convergent box subsequence. See also `flc_wiredIV_isTranslationInvariant` (unconditional for `q = 2`).

results.title: Translation invariance of the free FK measure from cylinder decay
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The free infinite-volume FK measure is translation invariant if cylinder decay holds for every shift and every convergent box subsequence. See also `bdp_freeIV_isTranslationInvariant` (unconditional for `q = 2`).

results.title: Equal wired densities from merging wired marginals
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: If the wired marginals of two box edges on `Λ_{N+k}` differ by a quantity tending to zero, the two edges have the same wired density.

results.title: Translation invariance of the wired density given merging marginals
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: An edge and its translate have the same wired density if their wired marginals merge along the boxes. See also `bdp_wiredEdgeDensity_translation_inv`, which proves the conclusion without the merging hypothesis.

results.title: Translation invariance of the free density given merging marginals
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: An edge and its translate have the same free density if their free marginals merge along the boxes. See also `bdp_freeEdgeDensity_translation_inv`, which proves the conclusion without the merging hypothesis.

results.title: Translation invariance of free and wired densities if marginals merge

results.title: Constant wired density gives a lower bound on expected open edges
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: If the wired density is constant on a set `EB` of box edges, `|EB|` times that density is at most the expected number of open edges of `EB` under the wired measure on any larger box.

results.title: Constant free density gives an upper bound on expected open edges
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: If the free density is constant on a set `EB` of box edges, the expected number of open edges of `EB` under the free measure on any larger box is at most `|EB|` times that density.

results.title: Wired lower bound on expected open edges along a box-symmetry orbit

results.title: Translated box edges are shifted centered box edges
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: Including a translated box edge equals shifting the included centered box edge by `v`.

results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The image of a translated edge set in `ℤ^d` is the shift by `v` of the image of the centered set.

results.title: Wired all-open probability on a translated box
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The probability, under the wired `q = 2` FK measure on the translated box `v + Λ_m`, that all edges of the translated copy of `t ⊆ E(Λ_N)` are open.

results.title: Translated wired box mass equals the centered box mass
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: The translated wired box mass equals the probability of the unshifted event under the wired finite-volume measure on the centered box `Λ_m`.

results.title: Translated wired box masses converge to the infinite-volume mass

results.title: Wired shift invariance of an all-open event from matching limits
results.caption: Lemma

results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: If the translated wired box masses differ from the centered box masses of a set `t'` with `v + t = t'` by a sequence tending to zero, the wired infinite-volume measure gives `t` and `v + t` the same probability.

results.title: Wired translation invariance from the placement hypothesis
results.caption: Lemma

results.title: Translated free box mass of an edge set

results.title: Translated free box mass equals the centred box probability

results.title: Translated free box masses converge to the free infinite-volume value
